extName.message: Parents Reminder – School Pickup & Schedule Alerts
extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions

extDescription.message: Never miss school pickup or drop-off. Desktop and voice reminders for your kids' daily schedule, activities, and routines.
extDescription.description: Extension short description shown in the Chrome Web Store

appName.description: Brand name, shown in the toolbar tooltip, app header, and notification title

homeEmptyDescription.message: Add your first child to start receiving helpful pickup reminders

addChild.description: Button on the home screen empty state

childCardNotScheduled.description: Shown on a child card when today has no schedule entry

childCardPaused.description: Shown on a child card when the child is disabled

childAddTitle.description: Header title on the Add Child screen

childEditTitle.description: Header title on the Edit Child screen

childNotFound.description: Shown when editing a child id that no longer exists

goBack.description: Button to return home from the child-not-found screen

minBefore.description: Suffix after the early-reminder minutes input

photoLoadFailed.description: Toast error when a selected photo fails to compress/load

feedback.description: Title/aria-label on the settings feedback button

voiceNotifDescription.message: Enable voice notifications to announce reminders aloud

systemNotifDescription.message: Receive visually enhanced reminders in your system tray

anonymousModeDescription.message: Hide child names in notifications, badges, and voice alerts to protect privacy in public places

dismiss.description: Title/aria-label on the floating popup's close button

supportMsg3.message: Ran into a problem or bug?

notificationMessage.description: Desktop notification body: child name, time

ttsAnnouncement.description: Spoken TTS phrase (non-anonymous mode). English keeps the brand name since it's spoken natively; other locales omit it to avoid an accented mispronunciation.

ttsAnnouncementAnonymous.description: Spoken TTS phrase in anonymous mode (no child name)

changelog340Localization.message: Added support for Spanish, Polish, French, German, and Ukrainian — the app, notifications, and voice reminders now follow your browser's language automatically.
